objects.description: 2D UV coordinate pair (u, v) used for texture mapping and distortion mapping. Plain-old-data; no ownership or lifecycle requirements.
Enumerates which eye (left or right) is being referenced for rendering or computation.
Enumerates the device/screen viewport orientation used when computing head pose and rendering.
Enumerates supported OpenGL ES texture targets for eye textures (GL_TEXTURE_2D or GL_TEXTURE_EXTERNAL_OES).
Indexed 2D mesh (x,y) with per-vertex UVs for lens distortion rendering. Buffers are raw pointers owned by the creator; lifetime must outlive uses (e.g., when set on the renderer).
Describes an eye texture and its UV bounds. The texture handle is API-dependent (GL/Vulkan/Metal) passed as an integer or bridged pointer managed by the caller.
Configuration for OpenGL ES distortion renderer, indicating which texture target will be used for eye textures.
Configuration for Metal distortion renderer including MTLDevice and pixel formats. CF/Metal objects are passed as bridged pointers and managed by the caller.
Configuration for Vulkan distortion renderer including VkPhysicalDevice, VkDevice, and VkSwapchainKHR handles, all managed by the caller.
Per-frame Metal target info: MTLRenderCommandEncoder (bridged pointer) and full screen dimensions. Ownership remains with caller; encoder must be valid during rendering.
Per-frame Vulkan target info: VkRenderPass, VkCommandBuffer (must be begun), and target swapchain image index. Handles managed by caller.
Opaque handle for lens distortion computations and data (projections, eye-from-head, field of view, and generated distortion meshes). Managed via create/destroy functions.
Opaque handle for the distortion renderer that composites eye textures to the display using GL ES, Metal, or Vulkan. Must be used on the render thread.
Opaque handle for head pose prediction using device sensors. Provides pose queries, pause/resume, recenter, and optional low-pass filtering.

functions.name: CardboardLensDistortion_create
functions.signature: CardboardLensDistortion* CardboardLensDistortion_create(const uint8_t* encoded_device_params, int size, int display_width, int display_height);
functions.description: Creates a lens distortion object using serialized viewer/device parameters and the display size. Use it to query eye transforms, projection, FOV, meshes, and UV distortion mapping. Returns nullptr if encoded_device_params is null.
requirements: encoded_device_params must not be null; otherwise the call is a no-op and returns nullptr.
size is the byte size of encoded_device_params (no explicit range constraints documented).
display_width and display_height are display dimensions in pixels (no explicit range constraints documented).
The returned object must be destroyed with CardboardLensDistortion_destroy.

functions.name: CardboardLensDistortion_destroy
functions.description: Destroys and releases resources held by a CardboardLensDistortion object.
requirements: lens_distortion must not be null; otherwise the call is a no-op.
Any meshes obtained via CardboardLensDistortion_getDistortionMesh become invalid after destruction.

functions.name: CardboardLensDistortion_getEyeFromHeadMatrix
functions.signature: void CardboardLensDistortion_getEyeFromHeadMatrix(CardboardLensDistortion* lens_distortion, CardboardEye eye, float* eye_from_head_matrix);
functions.description: Writes the 4x4 eye-from-head transform matrix for the requested eye into eye_from_head_matrix. Use to position each eye relative to the head for stereo rendering.
requirements: lens_distortion must not be null; otherwise the call is a no-op and an identity matrix is returned.
eye_from_head_matrix must not be null; otherwise the call is a no-op and an identity matrix is returned.
eye must be a valid CardboardEye value (kLeft or kRight).
eye_from_head_matrix must point to storage for 16 floats.

functions.name: CardboardLensDistortion_getProjectionMatrix
functions.signature: void CardboardLensDistortion_getProjectionMatrix(CardboardLensDistortion* lens_distortion, CardboardEye eye, float z_near, float z_far, float* projection_matrix);
functions.description: Computes the ideal projection matrix for the given eye and near/far clip planes and writes a 4x4 float matrix to projection_matrix.
requirements: lens_distortion must not be null; otherwise the call is a no-op and an identity matrix is returned.
projection_matrix must not be null; otherwise the call is a no-op and an identity matrix is returned.
eye must be a valid CardboardEye value.
z_near and z_far specify clip plane distances (no explicit range constraints documented).
projection_matrix must point to storage for 16 floats.

functions.name: CardboardLensDistortion_getFieldOfView
functions.signature: void CardboardLensDistortion_getFieldOfView(CardboardLensDistortion* lens_distortion, CardboardEye eye, float* field_of_view);
functions.description: Gets per-eye field-of-view half angles in radians as [left, right, bottom, top] and writes them to field_of_view.
requirements: lens_distortion must not be null; otherwise the call is a no-op and returns default values (all angles = 45 degrees).
field_of_view must not be null; otherwise the call is a no-op and returns default values (all angles = 45 degrees).
eye must be a valid CardboardEye value.
field_of_view must point to storage for 4 floats.

functions.name: CardboardLensDistortion_getDistortionMesh
functions.signature: void CardboardLensDistortion_getDistortionMesh(CardboardLensDistortion* lens_distortion, CardboardEye eye, CardboardMesh* mesh);
functions.description: Fills mesh with the distortion mesh for the specified eye, used by the distortion renderer to map eye textures to the display.
requirements: lens_distortion must not be null; otherwise the call is a no-op and returns default empty values.
mesh must not be null; otherwise the call is a no-op and returns default empty values.
eye must be a valid CardboardEye value.
The returned mesh data becomes invalid if the associated CardboardLensDistortion is destroyed.

functions.name: CardboardLensDistortion_undistortedUvForDistortedUv
functions.signature: CardboardUv CardboardLensDistortion_undistortedUvForDistortedUv(CardboardLensDistortion* lens_distortion, const CardboardUv* distorted_uv, CardboardEye eye);
functions.description: Maps a UV from pre-distortion (eye texture) space to post-distortion (screen) space using the inverse lens distortion model. Returns [-1, -1] if preconditions are not met.
requirements: lens_distortion must not be null; otherwise the call is a no-op and returns an invalid UV (-1,-1).
distorted_uv must not be null; otherwise the call is a no-op and returns an invalid UV (-1,-1).
Input and output UVs are normalized to [0,1] (no additional range enforcement documented).
eye must be a valid CardboardEye value.

functions.name: CardboardLensDistortion_distortedUvForUndistortedUv
functions.signature: CardboardUv CardboardLensDistortion_distortedUvForUndistortedUv(CardboardLensDistortion* lens_distortion, const CardboardUv* undistorted_uv, CardboardEye eye);
functions.description: Maps a UV from post-distortion (screen) space to pre-distortion (eye texture) space using the lens distortion model. Returns [-1, -1] if preconditions are not met.
requirements: lens_distortion must not be null; otherwise the call is a no-op and returns an invalid UV (-1,-1).
undistorted_uv must not be null; otherwise the call is a no-op and returns an invalid UV (-1,-1).
Input and output UVs are normalized to [0,1] (no additional range enforcement documented).
eye must be a valid CardboardEye value.

functions.name: CardboardOpenGlEs2DistortionRenderer_create
functions.description: Creates a distortion renderer that uses OpenGL ES 2.0. Must be called from the render thread. The returned renderer is used to set meshes and render eyes to the display.
requirements: Must be called from the render thread.
config specifies OpenGL ES texture type (no explicit non-null requirement documented).
Destroy the returned object with CardboardDistortionRenderer_destroy from the render thread.

functions.name: CardboardOpenGlEs3DistortionRenderer_create
functions.description: Creates a distortion renderer that uses OpenGL ES 3.0. Must be called from the render thread.
requirements: Must be called from the render thread.
config specifies OpenGL ES texture type (no explicit non-null requirement documented).
Destroy the returned object with CardboardDistortionRenderer_destroy from the render thread.

functions.name: CardboardMetalDistortionRenderer_create
functions.description: Creates a distortion renderer that uses Metal. Must be called from the render thread. The config carries a CFTypeRef to a MTLDevice and pixel format enums.
requirements: Must be called from the render thread.
config.mtl_device must be a valid CFTypeRef to a MTLDevice that remains valid during the call (client manages ownership and validity as per comments).
Color, depth, and stencil attachment pixel formats must be valid MTLPixelFormat enum values.

functions.name: CardboardVulkanDistortionRenderer_create
functions.description: Creates a distortion renderer that uses Vulkan. Must be called from the render thread. The config provides Vulkan handles for physical device, logical device, and swapchain.
requirements: Must be called from the render thread.
config.physical_device, config.logical_device, and config.vk_swapchain must be valid Vulkan objects maintained by the caller during the call (no explicit lifetime beyond the call documented).

functions.name: CardboardDistortionRenderer_destroy
functions.description: Destroys and releases resources held by a CardboardDistortionRenderer. Must be called from the render thread.
requirements: Must be called from the render thread.
renderer must not be null; otherwise the call is a no-op.

functions.name: CardboardDistortionRenderer_setMesh
functions.signature: void CardboardDistortionRenderer_setMesh(CardboardDistortionRenderer* renderer, const CardboardMesh* mesh, CardboardEye eye);
functions.description: Sets the distortion mesh for the specified eye on the renderer. Must be called from the render thread.
requirements: Must be called from the render thread.
renderer must not be null; otherwise the call is a no-op.
mesh must not be null; otherwise the call is a no-op.
eye must be a valid CardboardEye value.

functions.name: CardboardDistortionRenderer_renderEyeToDisplay
functions.signature: void CardboardDistortionRenderer_renderEyeToDisplay(CardboardDistortionRenderer* renderer, uint64_t target, int x, int y, int width, int height, const CardboardEyeTextureDescription* left_eye, const CardboardEyeTextureDescription* right_eye);
functions.description: Renders the left and right eye textures into a rectangle of the display. Must be called from the render thread. The target parameter is an API-specific handle: OpenGL ES uses a GLuint; Metal uses a pointer to CardboardMetalDistortionRendererTargetConfig; Vulkan uses a pointer to CardboardVulkanDistortionRendererTarget.
requirements: Must be called from the render thread.
renderer must not be null; otherwise the call is a no-op.
left_eye must not be null; otherwise the call is a no-op.
right_eye must not be null; otherwise the call is a no-op.
For Vulkan, the command buffer in the target must be started before calling (renderer.command_buffer must be started).
For Vulkan targets, swapchain_image_index must be less than the swapchain image count; otherwise the renderer returns without rendering.
For Metal targets, render_command_encoder must remain valid during the call; caller manages CFTypeRef retain/release as shown in comments.
For textures in CardboardEyeTextureDescription: the underlying image/texture object must remain valid for the duration of the call; caller manages ownership and pointer validity.
x, y, width, height specify the destination rectangle in pixels (no explicit range constraints documented).

functions.name: CardboardHeadTracker_create
functions.description: Creates a head tracker that fuses accelerometer and gyroscope data to predict head pose. Use with getPose/pause/resume/recenter and destroy when done.
requirements: No explicit preconditions documented.
Destroy with CardboardHeadTracker_destroy when no longer needed.

functions.name: CardboardHeadTracker_destroy
functions.description: Destroys a head tracker and releases its resources.
requirements: head_tracker must not be null; otherwise the call is a no-op.

functions.name: CardboardHeadTracker_pause
functions.description: Pauses the head tracker and underlying device sensors.
requirements: head_tracker must not be null; otherwise the call is a no-op.

functions.name: CardboardHeadTracker_resume
functions.description: Resumes the head tracker and underlying device sensors.
requirements: head_tracker must not be null; otherwise the call is a no-op.

functions.name: CardboardHeadTracker_getPose
functions.signature: void CardboardHeadTracker_getPose(CardboardHeadTracker* head_tracker, int64_t timestamp_ns, CardboardViewportOrientation viewport_orientation, float* position, float* orientation);
functions.description: Computes the predicted head pose (position and orientation quaternion) for the given timestamp and viewport orientation. Returns zeros and identity quaternion if preconditions are unmet.
requirements: head_tracker must not be null; otherwise the call is a no-op and returns default values.
position must not be null; otherwise the call is a no-op and returns default values.
orientation must not be null; otherwise the call is a no-op and returns default values.
timestamp_ns must be in the correct time domain: Android uses CLOCK_BOOTTIME; iOS uses CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW.
position must point to storage for 3 floats (x,y,z).
orientation must point to storage for 4 floats (quaternion).
viewport_orientation must be a valid CardboardViewportOrientation value.

functions.name: CardboardHeadTracker_recenter
functions.description: Recenters the head tracker so that the current orientation aligns to zero yaw.
requirements: head_tracker must not be null.

functions.name: CardboardHeadTracker_setLowPassFilter
functions.description: Enables/sets a low-pass filter on the head tracker with the given cutoff frequency to reduce high-frequency noise. Optional to use.
requirements: head_tracker must be a valid pointer (no explicit null-precondition documented, but it is a standard object method).
cutoff_frequency is an integer cutoff in Hz (no explicit valid range documented).

functions.name: CardboardQrCode_getSavedDeviceParams
functions.description: Retrieves the currently saved device parameters from storage, allocating memory for the serialized proto. The caller must release it with CardboardQrCode_destroy.
requirements: encoded_device_params must not be null; otherwise the call is a no-op and returns default empty values.
size must not be null; otherwise the call is a no-op and returns default empty values.
The returned buffer must be released with CardboardQrCode_destroy.

functions.name: CardboardQrCode_destroy
functions.description: Releases memory allocated for device parameters returned by CardboardQrCode_getSavedDeviceParams.
requirements: encoded_device_params must not be null; otherwise the call is a no-op.
Only pass pointers allocated by CardboardQrCode_getSavedDeviceParams.

functions.name: CardboardQrCode_saveDeviceParams
functions.signature: void CardboardQrCode_saveDeviceParams(const uint8_t* uri, int size);
functions.description: Parses a Cardboard QR-code URI to obtain encoded device parameters and saves them. Supports HTTPS, will replace HTTP with HTTPS, and follows up to 5 redirects. Increments the device params changed counter on successful save.
requirements: uri must not be null.
size must be greater than 0.
URI must be a supported Cardboard format (e.g., https://g.co/cardboard for v1 or https://google.com/cardboard/cfg?p=... for v2); HTTP is automatically replaced with HTTPS.
On success, increments the counter accessible via CardboardQrCode_getDeviceParamsChangedCount.

functions.name: CardboardQrCode_scanQrCodeAndSaveDeviceParams
functions.description: Launches a QR code scan and, if a valid Cardboard viewer code is found, saves the encoded device parameters. Increments the device params changed counter on successful save.
requirements: No parameters. Behavior depends on platform UI integration (not documented here).
On successful save, increments the counter accessible via CardboardQrCode_getDeviceParamsChangedCount.

functions.name: CardboardQrCode_getDeviceParamsChangedCount
functions.description: Returns the count of successful device parameter read-and-save operations performed so far.
requirements: No parameters and no explicit preconditions.

functions.name: CardboardQrCode_getCardboardV1DeviceParams
functions.description: Provides built-in Cardboard V1 device parameters without using external storage. The returned pointer refers to internally managed memory; callers must not free it. Does not require Cardboard_initializeAndroid on Android.
requirements: encoded_device_params must not be null; otherwise the call is a no-op and returns default empty values.
size must not be null; otherwise the call is a no-op and returns default empty values.
Do not free the returned pointer; ownership is retained by the library.
Does not require a prior call to Cardboard_initializeAndroid on Android.

endpoints.name: CardboardQrCode_getDeviceParamsChangedCount
